sights.address: 5300 Tyner St NW (East Sippo entrance), Perry Township, OH
sights.w: A 300-acre Stark Parks lake park in Perry Township, bought in 1977 with a federal block grant covering Sippo Lake and 100 surrounding acres, with hiking, biking, fishing and boating. Stark Parks recently added an accessible kayak and canoe launch.

Alliance's castle: a three-storey mansion built 1904–09 for Col. William Henry Morgan of the Morgan Engineering Co. and named for his father's birthplace in Wales. Listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1972. Restoration plans were in the news recently.

sights.address: Lake Anna Park, downtown Barberton, OH
sights.w: A 21-acre park around a spring-fed 10-acre glacial lake at the heart of downtown Barberton, named by city founder O.C. Barber after his only daughter, Anna Laura. It has a bandstand gazebo for summer concerts, the city War Memorial, and a statue of Barber.
